name: full-provider-review
description: Interactive native-provider review team: Pi lead, Claude reviewer, Agy validator, Agy reviewer. Consumes provider/model tokens.

agents.name: pi-lead
agents.task: Synthesize review scope and evidence. Coordinate independent peers; do not modify files.

agents.name: claude-reviewer
agents.task: Review correctness, authority and security boundaries. Do not edit files; provide deterministic reproductions.

agents.name: agy-validator
agents.task: Run focused validation of acceptance criteria. Do not edit production files; report exact results and skipped probes.

agents.name: agy-reviewer
agents.task: Review performance, bounded retention, concurrency and shutdown behavior. Do not edit files; substantiate findings.

notes: Best for non-trivial review/QA where independent native CLIs help.
Keep the task objective bounded; inspect captured panes/result files before accepting PASS.
